provenance_note: All client, vendor, designer, and contact data excluded at extraction. K-12 school athletics vertical retained; slogan/mascot copy excluded, copy structure retained.

materials_manifest.product: digitally printed full-coverage mural on 3M heat-applied textured-surface wall film
materials_manifest.spec: full-bleed coverage; textured-surface film heat-conformed to masonry wall

dimensions.note: Single continuous wall mural; tiled/seamed across panels in production.

copy_blocks.treatment: oversized dimensional-look wordmark across the wall

rules_observations: A single dominant oversized wordmark holds one primary read along a long corridor/gym wall at distance.
craft_observations: Full-coverage textured-film mural turns an entire block wall into the brand surface; the dimensional-look rendering fakes depth without fabrication.
Heat-conformed textured film keeps the print married to the wall texture across a 100ft run.

aesthetic_notes.note: Immersive spirit-wall approach typical of athletic facilities; impact comes from scale and a tight purple/black palette rather than detail.

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on method, film, and overall size
extraction_meta.notes: Distinct from the contour-cut wall graphics: full-coverage mural (contour_cut false), same 3M textured wall film family.
